Which enzyme is responsible for adding a poly-A tail to mRNA in eukaryotes?

text_solutions: Poly-A polymerase adds a poly-A tail to mRNA to enhance its stability and regulate translation.

qns_content.text: Which of the following correctly describes the role of a spliceosome?

options.text: It adds a poly-A tail to mRNA.

text_solutions: The spliceosome removes introns from pre-mRNA and joins the exons together to form mature mRNA.

qns_content.text: Which of the following statements about operons is correct?

options.text: Operons are found only in eukaryotic cells.
An operon consists of multiple genes controlled by a single promoter.
The lac operon is always active, regardless of lactose availability.

text_solutions: Operons are clusters of genes under the control of a single promoter, found mainly in prokaryotic cells.

qns_content.text: Which of the following is the template strand of DNA in transcription?

text_solutions: The non-coding strand (also called the template strand) serves as the template for RNA synthesis in transcription.

qns_content.text: Which enzyme is responsible for unwinding the DNA double helix during replication?

text_solutions: Helicase unwinds the DNA double helix, allowing replication to proceed.
